movements.name: Dumbbell Flye
movements.instructions: Lie on a flat bench with the dumbbells over the chest and the palms facing each other. Open the arms in a wide arc with one soft elbow angle until the chest reaches an owned stretch. Bring the bells back along the same arc, like hugging a barrel. Keep control through the return; the rep is won in the long arc, not by crashing the bells together at the top.
movements.cues: Elbow angle locked the whole arc. Open to a deep working stretch, then hug the barrel back up. Lighter than you think — this movement punishes ego.

movements.name: Decline Dumbbell Flyes
movements.instructions: Secure the legs on a decline bench, lie back and hold a dumbbell in each hand above the chest with the palms facing each other and the arms almost straight. With a slight, fixed bend in the elbows, lower the arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across the chest. Bring the dumbbells back together above the chest along the same arc.
movements.cues: Keep the elbow bend fixed. Open wide, slowly. Squeeze the chest to close.

movements.name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
movements.instructions: Lie back on a bench set to a low incline holding a dumbbell in each hand above the chest, arms almost straight. Keeping the same slight bend in the elbows, lower the arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across the chest. Bring the dumbbells back up along the same arc to the start.
movements.cues: Keep the elbow bend fixed. Move only at the shoulders. Lower slowly.
